name: rounded-block
prompt: Make a block 2 m long, 1 m tall and 0.5 m deep with every edge rounded by 0.03 m.

name: raised-panel
prompt: Make a 1 m cube with a square panel on its top: inset the top face by 0.2 m, then raise the inner square 0.1 m.

name: thick-wall
prompt: Make a flat wall 4 m wide and 2.5 m tall from a quad grid (poly.grid, 4 columns by 2 rows) and give it a thickness of 0.2 m.

name: pyramid-roof
prompt: Make a pyramid roof: a flat square slab 3 m by 3 m and 0.1 m thick with a peak raised 1 m above its top face.

name: wire-cage
prompt: Make a wire cage: a 1 m cube turned into a frame of struts about 0.05 m thick with no solid faces.

name: mirror-half
prompt: Build only the right half (x from 0 to 1) of a box that is 2 m wide, 1 m tall and 1 m deep, from polygon tools, then mirror it with the symmetrize tool so the whole box is made from the half.

name: stepped-tower
prompt: Make a tower: a 1 m by 1 m by 3 m box, then twice inset the top face by 0.15 m and extrude the inner square up 0.8 m, so it steps in like a wedding cake.

name: crate-with-recess
prompt: Make a crate: a 1 m cube with all edges slightly rounded (0.04 m) and a square recess 0.6 m wide sunk 0.05 m into the front face (the +z face).

name: cut-edge
prompt: Take a 1 m cube as an editable polygon mesh and subdivide its top front edge (along x, at the top, +z side) into 4 pieces with the polygon subdivide tool.

name: uv-cube
prompt: Make a 1 m cube as a polygon mesh and unwrap it to UV coordinates, cutting along its sharp edges.

name: house
prompt: Make a small house: a box 4 m wide, 3 m deep and 2.5 m tall with a pyramid roof 1.5 m high on top, edges slightly rounded (0.05 m), walls beige and roof dark red.

name: lod-sphere
prompt: Make a low-detail (LOD) version of a smooth sphere: a sphere of radius 1 m with 64 segments, reduced to about a quarter of its triangles while keeping its shape. The only output should be the low-detail sphere (no comparison copy).

name: plinth
prompt: Make a plinth: a 1.2 m by 1.2 m by 0.4 m block, its top inset by 0.1 m and pressed down 0.05 m (a shallow recess), all outer edges rounded 0.02 m.
